notes: These records describe private live Guild Skills and local source bodies for future version updates.
The skill records were created with guild skill create and versioned with guild skill version create.
Each overview is human-facing for guild skill create --overview.
Each runtimeDescription is agent-facing for guild skill version create --description.
Each bodyFile points to the markdown body to pass with --body-file.
Each initialVersion records the first published version. Each currentVersion records the latest published version generated from these body files.
Agents should declare the requiredRuntimeIntegration only after live skill versions exist and runtime activation is intentionally enabled.
